mic-test.does: Runs in the browser. Asks for microphone access, shows a live level meter and the loudest level so far, lets you pick which microphone if you have several, records a clip of up to 10 seconds and plays it back. Nothing is uploaded or saved.

webcam-test.does: Runs in the browser. Shows a live, mirrored camera preview, lets you pick the camera if you have several, shows the resolution and frame rate the camera reports, mirror toggle, snapshot you can download as PNG. Nothing is uploaded.

speaker-test.does: Runs in the browser. Plays a test tone in the left speaker only, right only, or both; frequency slider from 100 to 2000 Hz; a sweep from 100 to 2000 Hz; volume slider; left/right indicators light up while playing.

keyboard-test.does: Runs in the browser. On-screen keyboard (letters, numbers, F-keys, modifiers, arrows, numpad on wider screens); keys light up while pressed and stay marked once tested; shows the last key's key, code and keyCode; counter of tested keys; reset. Some system keys (Windows key, volume, Fn) never reach a web page.

click-speed-test.does: Runs in the browser. Clicks-per-second test with 1, 5, 10, 30 or 60 second timers; live CPS, total clicks, final CPS and a rating; personal best saved in the browser; spacebar mode and right-click mode.

dead-pixel-test.does: Runs in the browser. Fills the screen (fullscreen) with solid colours: black, white, red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta; click or press the arrow keys or space for the next colour, Esc to exit. Helps spot dead (always dark) and stuck (always one colour) pixels.

screen-recorder.does: Runs in the browser (desktop Chrome, Edge, Firefox; not phones). Records a screen, window or tab you choose; optional microphone and tab/system audio; 3-2-1 countdown, pause, timer; download the recording as WebM. No watermark, no sign-up, nothing uploaded.

dictation.does: Runs in the browser's own speech recognition (Chrome, Edge, Safari work best). Tap the mic and talk; text appears live and can be edited; many languages; spoken punctuation in English (comma, period, question mark, new line, new paragraph); copy, clear, download .txt; word count. Chrome may send audio to Google's speech service; Lazur does not receive it.

voice-typing.does: Runs in the browser's own speech recognition. Pick a language (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Malayalam, Kannada, Punjabi, Urdu, Sinhala, English, Spanish, French, Arabic); speak and get text in that language's script; copy, clear, open WhatsApp with the text. Chrome and Edge support the most languages.

audio-to-text.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Audio or video file (file: audio/*,video/*). What it does: Transcribe this audio word for word. Add punctuation and paragraph breaks. Do not summarize or translate. If there is no speech, reply exactly: No speech found. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

voice-note-to-text.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Voice note (file: audio/*,.opus,.ogg,.m4a). What it does: Transcribe this voice note word for word, in the language spoken, with punctuation and paragraph breaks. If there is no speech, reply exactly: No speech found. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

voice-recorder.does: Runs in the browser. Records from the microphone with a level meter and timer; pause and resume; play back and download the recording (WebM/OGG/MP4, whichever the browser makes); a live transcript alongside when the browser supports speech recognition. Nothing is uploaded.

audio-to-notes.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Recording (file: audio/*,video/*); Notes style: Short summary + bullet points / Detailed notes / Action items only. What it does: Listen to this recording and turn it into clear notes in the requested style. Start with a one-line title. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

youtube-transcript.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: YouTube link. What it does: Give the full transcript of this video, word for word, with punctuation and paragraph breaks. If you cannot access its speech, say so in one sentence. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

youtube-summarizer.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: YouTube link; Length: Key points / One paragraph / Detailed. What it does: Summarize this video in the requested length. Start with a one-line title. Be specific: names, numbers, steps. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

teleprompter.does: Runs in the browser. Paste a script; font size, scroll speed, line height, text width, mirror mode for glass rigs, a reading line; fullscreen auto-scroll; Space pauses, arrow keys change speed, +/- change text size, Esc exits; optional camera preview; the script is remembered in the browser.

words-to-minutes.does: Runs in the browser. Paste text or type a word count; pick a pace (slow 110, normal 130, fast 160 words per minute, or custom); shows speaking time, word count and pages, plus a table of how many words fit in 1 to 20 minutes.

pronunciation-checker.does: Runs in the browser's speech recognition. Type or pick a word or sentence, press Say it, and see each word marked right or wrong with what the engine heard, plus a score; Hear it plays the correct pronunciation with the browser's voice. Several languages. The browser's engine judges, so results show what a computer understands.

dictation-practice.does: Runs in the browser. English sentences at three levels (easy, medium, hard); the browser reads each one aloud (speed slider, replay, slow replay); you type what you hear; Check shows correct words in green and wrong or missing ones in red, an accuracy score and a running session score.

text-to-speech.does: Runs in the browser's built-in voices. Paste text, choose a voice (grouped by language), rate and pitch sliders, play, pause, resume, stop; character count; sample text.

read-pdf-aloud.does: Runs in the browser. Opens a PDF on your device, pulls out its text, and reads it aloud with the browser's voices (voice and speed choice, play, pause, stop, shows the current part). Scanned PDFs with no text layer can't be read; the page says so and suggests PDF to Text.

image-to-text.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Screenshot or photo (file: image/*). What it does: Extract all the text in this image exactly as written, in reading order, keeping line breaks. Output only the text. If there is no text, reply exactly: No text found. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

handwriting-to-text.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Photo of your notes (file: image/*). What it does: Read the handwriting in this image and type it out exactly, keeping line breaks. Mark any word you cannot read as [?]. Output only the text. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

image-to-excel.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Picture of a table (file: image/*). What it does: Extract the table in this image as CSV. First row is the header. Wrap any value containing a comma or quote in double quotes. Output only the CSV, nothing else, no code fences. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

pdf-to-text.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: PDF (file: application/pdf). What it does: Extract all the text from this PDF in reading order, keeping paragraphs and headings. For scanned pages, read the text from the image. Output only the text. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

chat-with-pdf.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: PDF (file: application/pdf); Your question. What it does: Answer the question using only this PDF. Be direct and short. Mention the page number when you can. If the PDF does not contain the answer, say so. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

image-to-prompt.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Image (file: image/*); For: Midjourney / DALL·E / Stable Diffusion / Any image AI. What it does: Write the text prompt that would make the named image AI produce an image like this one. Cover subject, style, lighting, colors, composition and camera or medium. One paragraph, then a line starting 'Negative prompt:' if it suits that engine. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

color-picker.does: Runs in the browser. Upload or drop an image, click anywhere (with a magnifier) to get the colour as HEX, RGB and HSL, copy any of them; history of the last 10 colours; extract a 6-colour palette from the image. Nothing is uploaded.

prompt-generator.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Your idea, as messy as you like; Writing for: ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / Any AI. What it does: Turn the person's rough idea into a clear, well-structured prompt for the named AI. Include role, task, context, constraints and the output format. Output only the prompt, ready to paste. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

excel-formula.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: What do you want it to do?; App: Excel / Google Sheets. What it does: Write the formula for the named app. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

sql-generator.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: What do you need?; Table names and columns (optional) (optional); Database: PostgreSQL / MySQL / SQL Server / SQLite / BigQuery. What it does: Write the SQL for the named database. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

regex-generator.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Describe the pattern; Sample text to test on (optional) (optional). What it does: Write the regular expression. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

email-reply.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: The email you got; What do you want to say?; Tone: Friendly / Professional / Short and direct / Apologetic. What it does: Write the reply to this email, saying what the person wants to say, in the requested tone. Start with the greeting, end with a sign-off, no subject line. Keep it as short as the situation allows. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

linkedin-message.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Type: Connection request / Follow-up / Cold outreach / Thank you / Asking for a referral; Who is it to and why?; Tone: Warm / Professional / Casual. What it does: Write the LinkedIn message. For a connection request keep it under 300 characters. Be specific, human and short, no buzzwords, no 'I hope this finds you well'. Write 2 different options. Separate the options with a line containing exactly ---OPTION---. No numbering, no labels, no text before the first option or after the last. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

text-reply.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: The message you got; Vibe: Friendly / Funny / Flirty / Polite no / Firm / Apology. What it does: Write 3 different reply options to this message in the requested vibe, each short and natural like a real text. Separate the options with a line containing exactly ---OPTION---. No numbering, no labels, no text before the first option or after the last. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

email-signature.does: Runs in the browser. Form for name, title, company, phone, email, website, LinkedIn and X links, photo URL, accent colour; four templates (Classic, Modern, Minimal, Bold); live preview; copy the signature as rich text to paste into Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail, or copy the HTML.

meeting-minutes.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Transcript or notes (optional); Or a recording (optional) (file: audio/*,video/*). What it does: Write clean meeting minutes from the transcript or recording. Sections: Summary (2-3 lines), Key decisions, Action items (owner and deadline if mentioned), Open questions. Never invent names or dates. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

summarizer.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Text; Length: Short / Medium / Bullet points. What it does: Summarize the text in the requested length. Keep the important facts, names and numbers. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

grammar-checker.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Text. What it does: Fix all spelling, grammar, punctuation and clarity mistakes without changing the meaning or voice. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

paraphrasing-tool.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Text; Style: Standard / Simple / More professional / Shorter / Creative. What it does: Rewrite the text in your own words in the requested style, keeping the meaning and facts. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

ai-humanizer.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: AI-written text. What it does: Rewrite this so it reads like a real person wrote it: varied sentence length, plain words, natural rhythm, no filler phrases like 'delve', 'in today's fast-paced world' or 'it is important to note'. Keep the meaning and facts. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

ai-detector.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Text to check. What it does: Estimate how likely this text was written by AI. Line 1: 'AI likelihood: X%' (a rough estimate, 0-100). Then 'Why:' with 3 short bullets pointing to specific phrases or patterns. End with: 'This is an estimate. No detector is fully reliable.' Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

word-counter.does: Runs in the browser. Live count of words, characters with and without spaces, sentences, paragraphs, reading time (238 wpm) and speaking time (130 wpm), average word length, most used words; limits for a tweet (280), SMS (160), meta description (160) and LinkedIn post (3000).

bio-generator.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Platform: Instagram / LinkedIn / Twitter / X / TikTok / Personal website / Dating app; About you; Tone: Professional / Playful / Minimal / Bold. What it does: Write 3 bio options for the platform, within its length norms, in the requested tone, using only facts from the person's description. Separate the options with a line containing exactly ---OPTION---. No numbering, no labels, no text before the first option or after the last. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

linkedin-headline.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: What you do; Who you help or want to impress (optional) (optional). What it does: Write 5 LinkedIn headlines, each under 220 characters, that say what the person does and for whom. Specific over clever, no 'passionate' or 'guru'. Separate the options with a line containing exactly ---OPTION---. No numbering, no labels, no text before the first option or after the last. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

linkedin-post.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Your idea; Style: Story / Lesson learned / Hot take / How-to list / Announcement. What it does: Write a LinkedIn post in the requested style, 120-220 words. A first line that earns the click, short lines, one idea, a closing line that invites a reply. No hashtag spam (max 3 at the end). Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

caption-generator.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Photo (optional) (optional) (file: image/*); Or describe it (optional); For: Instagram / LinkedIn / TikTok / Facebook / X. What it does: Write 5 captions for the platform about this photo and description. Vary the style (funny, short, thoughtful, question, bold). Add 3-5 fitting hashtags to each where the platform uses them. Separate the options with a line containing exactly ---OPTION---. No numbering, no labels, no text before the first option or after the last. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

cover-letter.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: The job post; Your resume or background. What it does: Write a cover letter for this job from the resume or background. 250-350 words, specific to the role, using only facts from the resume. Open with a hook, not 'I am writing to apply'. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.

resignation-letter.does: AI tool (Google Gemini on Lazur's servers; files up to 15 MB; answers in about 1-3 seconds, videos longer). Inputs: Your role and company; Last working day; Tone: Warm and grateful / Short and formal / Neutral; Anything to add (optional) (optional). What it does: Write a resignation letter in the requested tone, with the role, company and last working day. Professional, no drama, no blame. Free: 3 runs a day, 3 more after leaving an email; no account needed. Results can be copied with one click.
